behavior.arguments: rdi = minuend pointer (four 8-byte words, low word first); rsi = subtrahend pointer (four 8-byte words, low word first); no other argument is read
behavior.branch_order: no branches inside the window; one cmovne only, then ret
behavior.output_shape: rax = 1 iff 0 < minuend < subtrahend as unsigned 256-bit values, else 0, then ret
behavior.predicate_rule: return 1 iff (OR of the four minuend words != 0) AND (borrow-out of the four-word sub/sbb chain == 1), else 0
behavior.stored_results: none: the four-word difference lives only in caller-saved registers r8-r11 and is never stored to memory

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

naming_relocation.note: no relocation record of any type in any .rela.* section names this window as addend
